source_review.notes: Checked all six references against the official Google SRE site for identity, authorship or edition, and support for each nearby claim. Embracing Risk supports error budgets as the SLO-derived mechanism for balancing reliability and innovation. Implementing SLOs supports stakeholder agreement, attainability, policy, and refinement prerequisites. The published example policy supports a nonpunitive control response and its explicit urgent/security exceptions. Alerting on SLOs supports normalized burn rate, exhaustion interpretation, low-traffic cautions, and multiwindow alert trade-offs. All six canonical URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-06.

evidence: Defined window, valid, good and bad counts, target, budget rate, exact allowance, signed balance, remaining, overspend, consumption fraction, observation interval, bad rate, burn rate, time allowance, and overlapping bad-event sets before formal use.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Checked every inequality, ceiling, floor, set operator, subscript, percentage, and TeX delimiter for consistent meaning and GitHub rendering.

evidence: Recomputed 99.9% of 2,000,000 as 1,998,000 required good and 2,000 allowed bad; 1,500/2,000=75% consumed with 500 remaining.
Recomputed 120/50,000=0.24%, 0.24%/0.1%=2.4x, 28/2.4=11.6667 days, and half-budget exhaustion as 5.8333 days under stationary assumptions.
Recomputed 99% over 101 events as 100 minimum good and one maximum bad; 99/101=98.0198%.
Recomputed a 28-day 99.9% time allowance as 40.32 minutes and Exercise 1's 240,003-event allowance as 120.
Executed calculate-event-error-budget under CPython 3.14.4 and matched all three expected output lines exactly.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Exact Fraction arithmetic is used for the executable threshold and all displayed approximations state their assumptions or precision.

evidence: Derived the equivalence g/n >= theta iff b <= n-ceil(theta*n) for n>0 and b=n-g.
Verified n-ceil(theta*n)=floor((1-theta)*n) for integral n.
Checked signed balance decomposition into nonnegative remaining and overspend and burn normalization e/(1-theta).
Checked the two-set inclusion-exclusion formula for overlapping SLI failures.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The exhaustion relationship is explicitly conditional on comparable future event rate, population mix, and bad fraction rather than stated as a theorem for changing traffic.
